candidates.name: Kartik Kumar
candidates.headline: GenAI Specialist · Magna International
candidates.summary: AI Engineer with 2+ years delivering LLM-powered systems, multi-agent pipelines, and RAG architectures in enterprise automotive environments. BITS Pilani M.Tech (in progress). Strong systems thinker with demonstrated production impact — 80% task efficiency uplift, 85%+ LLM-human alignment.
candidates.narrative: AI engineer with two years of focused experience building and deploying LLM-powered systems, multi-agent pipelines, and RAG architectures in large enterprise environments. Joined Magna International via Tata Elxsi straight out of college, worked onsite with Mercedes, Jaguar, and Marelli on GenAI integration, and was directly absorbed by Magna as a GenAI Specialist within a year — a clear promotion signal. Has since architected an end-to-end multi-agent system that drove an 80% increase in user task efficiency and delivered a quality check system achieving 85%+ alignment with human evaluations at scale on Azure OpenAI and DataBricks. Completed a global onsite in Germany at Magna's European headquarters. Pursues personal projects that extend beyond work: an autonomous LinkedIn content pipeline, a smart LLM router with cost optimization analytics, and a biometrics research paper published at IEEE. Currently pursuing M.Tech at BITS Pilani (WILP) while working full-time. Strong systems thinker — articulates first principles over domain jargon, intellectually curious about applying AI to new verticals including fintech.
candidates.raw_text: AI Engineer with 2+ years of industry experience delivering LLM-powered systems, multi-agent pipelines, and RAG architectures in enterprise environments. Proficient in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, and cloud platforms including AWS and Azure. Demonstrated ability to take AI solutions from prototype to production, with measurable impact on efficiency, cost reduction, and engineering quality across automotive and technology sectors.
